issues_detected.title: Vertical Crack in Concrete Wall
issues_detected.description: A vertical crack is visible in the concrete wall, which may indicate settling or structural movement.
issues_detected.recommendation: Monitor the crack for any changes in size or shape. Consider consulting a structural engineer to assess the need for repairs.

analysis.overall_assessment: The vertical crack in the basement wall should be monitored for changes and evaluated by a professional to ensure structural integrity.
